configuration.query: FROM fraud-workshop-smurfing | WHERE account.event == "deposit" AND event.amount > 0 AND atm.deposit_type == "cash" | EVAL hour_minute = DATE_FORMAT("HH:mm", transaction.date) | STATS deposit_count = COUNT(), unique_times = COUNT_DISTINCT(hour_minute), avg_amount = AVG(event.amount), std_dev_amount = STD_DEV(event.amount) BY account.name, hour_minute | WHERE deposit_count > 1 | STATS regular_times = COUNT(), total_regular_deposits = SUM(deposit_count), avg_deposits_per_time = AVG(deposit_count), std_dev_timing = STD_DEV(deposit_count) BY account.name | WHERE regular_times >= 3 AND avg_deposits_per_time >= 2 | SORT regular_times DESC, total_regular_deposits DESC
